# rediscloud_iris_identity_subject_grant_set (Resource)

Manages a direct Iris identity resource, independently of Redis Cloud CAPI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rediscloud_iris_identity_subject_grant_set" "example" {
  tenant  = "your-tenant"
  issuer  = "https://issuer.example.com"
  subject = "user-123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subject` (String) The subject's user ID, taken from its token. Long enough for any Kubernetes ServiceAccount subject: system:serviceaccount: plus a 63-character namespace and a 253-character name.

### Optional

- `issuer` (String) The token issuer of the subject. Omit it to use the issuer of the caller's own token. A caller without a token issuer, such as the Control credential, must send it.
- `tenant` (String) The set's tenant. When the installation has a single tenant, omit it to use that tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A grant set ID: a random UUID as 32 lowercase hex characters.
- `products_json` (String) JSON-encoded service configuration. Use jsonencode(...).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rediscloud_iris_identity_subject_grant_set.example 44444444444444444444444444444444
```
